stories.title: Nvidia says it won't reinstate Huang as firm reports bumper results
stories.brief: The AI chip giant reported strong quarterly earnings on Tuesday after the dramatic exit of Jensen Huang.

stories.title: William and Kate celebrate Earthshot Prize winners in Mumbai
stories.brief: The Prince and Princess of Wales were joined by sporting and acting stars for the annual environmental awards ceremony.

stories.title: How new US chip restrictions on South East Asia will hit China
stories.brief: The new rules restrict chip exports and also access to their computing power, which China relies on heavily.

stories.title: Nvidia partner Megaspeed being investigated by US government over chip exports
stories.brief: The Singapore-based company is suspected of helping to ship high-end AI chips from tech giant Nvidia to China, violating US export rules.

stories.title: Over 170 major websites hit by attack, including BBC, Ikea and Air France: report
stories.brief: Nearly 200 major websites, including those of the BBC, HSBC UAE bank, Air France and Ikea were targeted by a malicious cyber attack seeking to steal financial information and infect Apple devices, specialist media reported on Tuesday.

stories.title: UK magazine listing points to loss of four Indian Rafales
stories.brief: A British aviation magazine has listed 32 Rafale fighter jets as being in active service with the Indian Air Force (IAF), four fewer than the 36 aircraft New Delhi has officially said it operates, according to its latest World Air Forces directory for 2027.

stories.title: Bilawal's statement on constitutional amendment could lead to 'disqualification', says Sanaullah
stories.brief: Sanaullah said Bilawal's statement on Tuesday was driven by anger over the issue of Sindh's division, acknowledging that the PPP had reservations about any proposal to divide the province or create new provinces within it.

stories.title: Buddhist leaders explore Pakistan’s ancient Gandhara heritage
stories.brief: Held under the theme "Towards a Shared Future", the dialogue aims to strengthen international cooperation for the preservation, promotion and global recognition of Gandhara's shared Buddhist heritage.

stories.title: ECP approves two-phase local polls in Punjab, first vote on Feb 7
stories.brief: The Election Commission of Pakistan (ECP) on Tuesday approved holding local government elections in Punjab in two phases, with the first phase scheduled for February 7, 2027.

stories.title: Tarar calls out Bilawal's 'double standards', says debate on new provinces cannot be stopped
stories.brief: Information Minister Attaullah Tarar on Tuesday called out the "double standards" of Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari, while arguing that the debate on new provinces and good governance could not be stopped.

stories.title: Waymo pulls driverless taxis from all US freeways
stories.brief: The decision comes after California banned Waymo's driverless vehicles from operating on the state's highways following a series of traffic incidents.

stories.title: Government risks missing climate targets if EV rules weakened, adviser warns
stories.brief: The UK could miss legally binding climate targets if EV targets are cut, an adviser warns

stories.title: Europe plans to catch the next computer chip wave
stories.brief: Europe hopes to be a leader in a new generation of computer chips which use light to process data.

stories.title: As Trump and Xi meet, China's AI dreams face an unexpected hurdle: the Nvidia spy scandal
stories.brief: China worries the scandal could ramp up pressure on the US to further restrict the sale of advanced chips.

stories.title: American soldier arrested by UK police on suspicion of spying taken into US military custody
stories.brief: The Metropolitan Police say he has been taken into custody by the US Military over suspected national security and espionage allegations.

stories.brief: The incident took place in Llwyneinion in August 1980.

stories.title: Nvidia board says it does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
stories.brief: The former Nvidia CEO said he would be "honored" to return if the board allowed. But the board says it has no intention of reinstating him.(Image credit: Benjamin Fanjoy)
